crm_notes:
Mid-market product team evaluating Hosted API trial (2 weeks) then moving to Dedicated. Team: Head of Product (Maya R), CTO (Liu Chen), ML Eng leads. Trial summary: observed mixed workload (assistant + some embeddings for search). Peak observed QPS on hosted trial: 12 rps; steady-state ~4-6 rps. Average concurrency during business hours 6-10, spikes to 20-30 during feature tests. Token mix: median request ~220 prompt tokens / ~380 generated tokens; 25% of calls include long context (1k+ tokens). Daily token volume at end of trial ~1.1M tokens/day. Latency: p95 ~280ms on hosted models, they want p95 <250ms for main assistant flows. Cost sensitivity: mid (wants to cut per-token cost by ~40% vs hosted list). Preferred models: open/Redwood-verified 13B quantized variants for cost; fallback to 7B for spikes. Routing/fallback needs: automatic downgrade to smaller model on high load; sticky routing per customer segment. Security: require SSO, SOC2 evidence, audit logs, KMS for key management. Notes from calls: 
- "Hosted trial showed good quality, want more stability under load" (Maya)
- SE demo covered autoscale and burst capacity; next ask is concrete GPU sizing and expected throughput per GPU.
POC artifacts: trial logs + sample QPS traces attached in Drive.
